results.quote: Theorem 1.1. _Given a 3-colorable graph G_=(_V,E_) _and a parameter r\>0_, there exists an algorithm that, with high probability, outputs a valid coloring of G using at most _O(r_) _colors in time_ \(O^*\left(exp\left(\tilde{O}\left(\frac{nlog^{11/2}r}{r^3}\right)\right)\right)\).
For any fixed real \(\epsilon\in(0,1/3)\), setting _r_ to be \(n^\epsilon\), we obtain a coloring of _G_ using \(O(n^\epsilon)\) colors in time \(O^*\left(exp\left(O(n^{1-3\epsilon})\right)\right)\).
